battle.name: 涇陽之戰
battle.brief: 武德九年六月初四（626年7月2日），建成死於玄武門，李元吉北走涇陽宮，尉遲敬德追至宮北門斬之，敬君弘、呂世衡力戰而死；次日張士貴率舊部在京師街道再戰，被世民騎兵擊破。卡面科林斯青銅盔為希臘重裝步卒裝備，與本役相隔逾千年，不在涇陽宮；現場交戰者為唐制兜鍪、明光鎧、佩刀、馬槊與弓弩。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 涇陽之戰沒有跨國交戰，交鋒發生在唐帝國皇室的兩個兄弟集團之間，而且只延續了不到一天。作戰一方是秦王李世民所率的西府集團：玄武門得手後，秦王府屬官長孫無忌、房玄齡、杜如晦、裴矩等立即控制皇城的出入，宿將秦叔寶、程知節、段志玄、公孫武達、劉師立與尉遲敬德分守門道並追擊齊王，兵源是秦府宿衛與隨行的關中、關東舊部。另一方是齊王李元吉的齊王府集團與東宮餘部：齊王府護衛敬君弘、呂世衡等，以及北衙宿軍中屬東宮、齊王一系的將校，左屯衛大將軍張士貴即率此類人馬在翌日京城街道上再起抵抗。指揮系統上此役沒有常設的戰場指揮官，兩邊都是宗室王府私屬部曲與皇城宿衛的混合體；一方靠臨陣封鎖門道取得主動，另一方靠對宮門與街巷地形的熟悉，加上臨時湊集的人數。戰場分兩處：長安城內玄武門北衙一線，以及京畿藍田縣的涇陽宮北門。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jingyang was not a war between states. The fighting was between two sets of brothers inside the imperial house of the Tang, and it lasted less than a day. On one side stood the West Depot party of Prince of Qin Li Shimin: once the ambush at Xuanwu Gate had succeeded, the officers of the Qin residence, Changsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui and Pei Ju, took control of the passages in and out of the imperial city, while veterans such as Qin Shubao, Cheng Zhijie, Duan Zhixuan, Gongsun Wuda, Liu Shili and Yuchi Jingde guarded the gate lanes and pursued the Prince of Qi. Their strength came from the household guard of the Qin residence and from veterans of the Guanzhong and Guandong campaigns. On the other side were the princely party of Li Yuanji and the remnants of the Eastern Palace: the retainers of the Qi residence, among them Jing Junhong and Lü Shiheng, together with officers of the Northern Gate guard who had belonged to the faction of the crown prince. Zhang Shigui, commander of the Left Garrison, led men of this kind back into the streets of the capital on the following morning. There was no theatre command on either side; each army was a mixture of princely household troops and palace guards, and the side that moved first did so by sealing a gate lane, while the other relied on its familiarity with the palace gates and streets and on numbers hastily gathered. The fighting took place in two places: the Northern Gate precinct of the Chang'an imperial city, and the north gate of Jingyang Palace in Lantian county in the capital's hinterland.
people: 此役的關鍵人物是唐高祖李淵的三個兒子與一批北衙將領。秦王李世民時年二十八歲，位尚書令、掌兵權，是玄武門與涇陽兩段行動的策劃者與直接指揮者；他在玄武門射殺太子李建成之後，立刻分兵追擊北走涇陽宮的齊王李元吉。齊王李元吉兼侍中、中書令，此前與太子李建成結盟，玄武門變中被尉遲敬德追上，在涇陽宮北門被殺。執行追擊的尉遲敬德自玄武門一路追到涇陽宮，手持單鞭，斬元吉於宮北門之下；隨行的秦叔寶、程知節、段志玄、公孫武達、劉師立各率甲士，負責封鎖通往涇陽宮的道路與宮門兩側。齊王府一方的護衛敬君弘、呂世衡在宮北門力戰而死，成為此役最硬的一處抵抗。翌日率舊部在京師街道再戰的是左屯衛大將軍張士貴，他被世民親率騎兵當面擊破而死。玄武門宿衛首長常何以宿衛聽命於東宮而見責，事變平息後被貶為潭州都督，以此表示朝廷對參與政變者的冷淡。
peopleEn: The key figures were the three sons of Tang emperor Gaozu and a group of commanders of the Northern Gate guard. Li Shimin, then twenty-eight years old, held the office of President of the Department of State Affairs and the command of the troops; he planned and personally directed both stages of the action, at Xuanwu Gate and at Jingyang. After the prince shot the crown prince at Xuanwu Gate, he split his force at once to pursue Li Yuanji, who had fled north to Jingyang Palace. Yuanji, who held the offices of Gentleman of the Palace and Director of the Secretariat, had allied with the crown prince; caught at Xuanwu Gate and pursued by Yuchi Jingde, he was killed at the north gate of Jingyang. Yuchi Jingde, who carried a single mace, rode from Xuanwu Gate all the way to Jingyang and struck Yuanji down below the north gate; Qin Shubao, Cheng Zhijie, Duan Zhixuan, Gongsun Wuda and Liu Shili led armoured men who sealed the roads to the palace and both sides of its gate. On the prince's side, the guards Jing Junhong and Lü Shiheng fought hard at the north gate and were killed there, giving the stiffest resistance of the day. The man who led the old retainers back into the streets of the capital on the following morning was Zhang Shigui, commander of the Left Garrison; he was broken in person by Li Shimin's cavalry and killed. Chang He, commander of the Xuanwu Gate watch, who had obeyed the crown prince during the watch, was held responsible; once the affair was over he was demoted to governor of Tanzhou, a mark of the court's coldness toward those who had taken part in the coup.
kits: 卡面那件科林斯青銅盔（Corinthian helmet）是古希臘重裝步兵的全正面青銅頭盔，約公元前六百五十年前後定型：頭盔罩住整個頭面，只在前部留出一條橫向窄開眼，兩側延伸至鼻樑與後腦，兩邊有覆耳的護片，盔頂起脊以便插羽與盔纓。它與唐初長安的戰鬥毫無關係，年代相差一千二百五十餘年，也沒有任何一條唐代軍備序列可以承接它；它在卡面上所標示的，是「以頭盔封閉戰士視野、逼其依靠隊形與互相掩護而活」這一兵器史母題。涇陽之戰的真實裝備屬唐制：護具是皮胎或鐵葉兜鍪、護膊、護腿，以及明光鎧、札甲；貼身佩橫刀、佩刀與長刀，長柄兵器有馬槊、方天戟與長槊；投射類是唐式直臂弓分為步射與馬射，另有臂弩與蹶張弩，箭鏃用鋼鐵。宮門道狹窄，馬槊與佩刀是近身格鬥的主器；馬匹在玄武門至涇陽宮的追擊中決定速度；火把、繩索、門扇與門閂在封門與搜捕時直接當作戰具。雙方都沒有攻城器械，也沒有雲梯與撞車一類的裝備。
kitsEn: The card weapon, the Corinthian helmet, was the full-face bronze helmet of the Greek heavy infantry, a form that took shape around 650 BC: it covered the whole head and face and left only a narrow horizontal eye slit across the front, the metal running forward to the bridge of the nose and back over the skull, with cheek pieces that covered the ears and a ridged crown on which a crest could be fixed. It has nothing to do with any fighting in early Tang Chang'an; it is more than twelve hundred and fifty years out of step, and no Tang armaments sequence can carry it. What the card marks is a theme in the history of weapons: a helmet that closes off the soldier's field of view and forces him to survive by the formation and by the shelter of his neighbour. The real equipment at Jingyang belongs to the Tang system. Protection was given by helmets of leather or iron plate, arm and leg guards, and armour of the ming-guang and zha types; at the belt were the cross-bladed dao and long swords; the pole weapons were the horse lance, the ge-tian ji and the long spear. For throwing, the Tang used the straight bow in its foot and mounted forms, together with the arm crossbow and the powerful draw crossbow, with steel or iron heads. In a narrow palace gate lane the lance and the dao were the weapons of the last close quarters, and the horses carried by the pursuers decided the speed of the chase. Torches, ropes, the gate leaves and the bolts of the doors served as weapons when the gates were sealed and the men hunted. Neither side had any siege engine, and there were no ladders or battering rams in a battle fought inside and outside a palace gate.
tactics: 涇陽之戰的戰術可以拆成兩段：破曉的追擊戰，和翌晨的街道殘戰。玄武門得手後，李世民不給齊王任何集結的時間：元吉北走涇陽宮，是往長安城外的近郊行宮方向；追兵以騎兵為主，自玄武門出發，沿驪山北麓與渭水北岸的道路疾追，在宮北門前咬住。敬君弘、呂世衡率齊王府護衛在宮門一線列陣，死守門道與牆角，使追兵無法一擁而入；尉遲敬德等下馬步戰，以佩刀與馬槊在狹窄的門洞與甬道內格鬥，逐一清掉門前的守衛，再殺元吉。涇陽宮一帶是皇帝行宮所在，有殿宇、馬廄與常設的廚膳供應，護衛與扈從馬匹可以在此歇馬換馬，這是行軍能夠當日往返的前提。翌日清晨，張士貴等齊王府舊部利用對京城街道與衙署門戶的熟悉，率眾在北衙與街巷中據街而拒，試圖以人數與地形換取喘息；世民親率騎兵直衝其陣，破散之後逐街搜捕餘黨，把殘餘的抵抗驅逐到城郊。整場戰役的勝負與雙方總人數無關，全靠位置、封鎖與時間：誰先把門道與街口堵住、誰能在天亮前把人清完，誰就決定了皇位歸屬。
tacticsEn: The Battle of Jingyang can be split into two parts: the pursuit in the grey light before dawn, and the street fighting of the following morning. Once the Xuanwu Gate had fallen, Li Shimin allowed Li Yuanji no time to gather himself: Yuanji's flight north to Jingyang Palace was toward the imperial lodge in the outskirts of the capital, and the pursuers rode after him along the road below the northern slopes of Mount Li and the northern bank of the Wei River, catching him at the north gate of the palace. Jing Junhong and Lü Shiheng drew up the retainers of the Qi residence at the gate line and held the passage and the corners of the wall, so that the pursuers could not flood in at once; Yuchi Jingde and the others dismounted and fought on foot, clearing the defenders one by one with dao and lance in the narrow gate tunnel before Yuanji was killed. Around Jingyang Palace, an imperial lodge with halls, stables and a standing kitchen, the horses of guards and escorts could be rested and remounted, and that is what made a march out and back in a single day possible. The next morning Zhang Shigui and the old men of the Qi residence, who knew the streets and the gates of the capital well, held the lanes and barricaded the junctions, hoping to buy time with numbers and terrain; Li Shimin rode straight into them, scattered them, and then hunted the survivors street by street, driving the last resistance out toward the outskirts. The outcome had nothing to do with the total number of men on either side. It was decided by position, by the closing of the way and by time: whoever sealed the gate lane and the street mouths first, and whoever could finish the clearing before dawn, decided who would hold the throne.
data: 關於涇陽之戰可查的數字不多，但有幾項可以確定。時間：武德九年六月初四，即西元626年7月2日，玄武門伏擊在破曉時發動，日出前後追擊至涇陽宮；六月初五（7月3日）清晨，京城街道再戰。場所：涇陽宮在長安以北的京畿藍田縣，位於渭水北岸、驪山北麓一帶，與長安城相去數十里，騎兵可當日往返，這正是史書記元吉「走至涇陽宮北門」的前提。兵員：玄武門一線投入的甲士，玄武門屯兵與秦王府隨行將士合計在數百人上下；追至涇陽宮的甲士為尉遲敬德、秦叔寶、程知節、段志玄、公孫武達、劉師立等所率的數十人；齊王府護衛在宮北門抵抗的也是數十人級別。翌日街道再戰，舊籍只說張士貴「率眾拒戰」，未留下確切人數，規模同樣有限。損失：當日陣亡與被斬首級者以數十計，含齊王李元吉、敬君弘、呂世衡與張士貴等；此後追誅、流放與貶黜的東宮、齊王府屬官亦達數十人，數字散見於《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》各傳，不宜相加為精確總數。整段事變自初四破曉到初五收束，歷時不足一日。
dataEn: Few figures survive for the Battle of Jingyang, but several can be fixed. The time: the fourth day of the sixth month of the ninth year of Wude, that is 2 July 626. The ambush at Xuanwu Gate was launched before dawn, and the pursuit reached Jingyang around sunrise; on the fifth day of the month, 3 July, in the early morning, the fighting in the streets of the capital took place. The place: Jingyang Palace stood in Lantian county in the hinterland north of Chang'an, on the northern bank of the Wei River below the northern slopes of Mount Li, some tens of li from the city wall, within a day's ride there and back for cavalry; that is what the record of Yuanji running to the north gate of Jingyang Palace presupposes. Numbers: the armoured men committed at Xuanwu Gate, the garrison of the gate together with the men of the Qin residence who accompanied the prince, came to some hundreds; the force that pursued to Jingyang was several dozen men led by Yuchi Jingde, Qin Shubao, Cheng Zhijie, Duan Zhixuan, Gongsun Wuda and Liu Shili; the retainers of the Qi residence who defended the north gate were of the same order, several dozen. The street fighting of the next morning is described in the old records only as Zhang Shigui leading his men to resist, with no exact number left, and its scale was likewise limited. Losses: those killed on the day and beheaded afterwards run to several dozen, among them the Prince of Qi, Jing Junhong, Lü Shiheng and Zhang Shigui; those later hunted down, killed, demoted or exiled from the offices of the two princely residences also number several dozen, the figures scattered through the Comprehensive Mirror to the Aid of Government and the biographies of the Old Tang History, and they should not be summed into a single exact total. The whole affair, from the ambush before dawn on the fourth day to the end of the fifth, ran less than a day in all.
cause: 涇陽之戰的起因，是唐初帝國最高權力的失衡在半年之內被逼到牆角。開國之後，李世民在滅隋、平竇建德與王世充、收復河東關中的戰爭中立功至偉，被封秦王、拜尚書令，總領兵權，士卒歸心向之；太子李建成居儲位而軍功才具皆遜於弟，遂與同樣封王的李元吉結盟，元吉又曾被東宮提議調世民出京遠征以削其兵權。父親李淵既倚重世民之兵，又不能廢已立之太子，更偏愛幼子，縱容兄弟傾軋。裴矩屢勸世民先行下手，以關中關東形勢相逼；房玄齡、杜如晦力主不可再拖，認為建成一旦入宮告變，突擊便不可能再複製。於是武德九年六月，世民先在玄武門發難，射殺建成，尉遲敬德斬元吉。涇陽之戰正是這個決定被推到底線的必然產物：元吉未死，齊王府的護衛與舊部就仍在京畿與京師之內，世民必須在同一天之內把這股力量連根拔除，否則昨日破曉的伏擊就會被翻盤。
causeEn: The cause of the Battle of Jingyang was that the imbalance of power at the top of the new Tang empire was driven against the wall within half a year. After the founding of the dynasty, Li Shimin had rendered enormous service in the campaigns that destroyed Sui, defeated Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong, and recovered Hedong and Guanzhong; he was made Prince of Qin and President of the Department of State Affairs, held the command of the troops, and the soldiers' hearts went with him. Li Jiancheng, who held the position of crown prince, was his elder brother yet was behind him in both achievement and ability, so he allied with Li Yuanji, likewise a crowned prince; and the Eastern Palace had proposed sending Li Shimin out of the capital on campaign so as to strip him of his troops. Their father Li Yuan could not dismiss the crown prince he had already installed, yet leaned on Li Shimin's soldiers and favoured the youngest son, and let the brothers' rivalry run its course. Pei Ju urged Li Shimin repeatedly to strike first, pressing the contrast between Guanzhong and Guandong on him; Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui insisted that delay was no longer possible, for if Li Jiancheng entered the palace to appeal, the surprise could never be repeated. So in the sixth month of the ninth year of Wude Li Shimin moved first at Xuanwu Gate, shot the crown prince and had Li Yuanji cut down by Yuchi Jingde. The Battle of Jingyang was the necessary consequence of that decision carried to its end: as long as the Prince of Qi lived, the retainers and old soldiers of his residence remained inside the capital and its hinterland, and Li Shimin had to tear that force out by the roots within the same day, or the ambush of the previous dawn would be thrown back in his face.
impact: 涇陽之戰的直接效果，是把玄武門之變從一場成功的暗殺變成一件無法逆轉的既成事實。元吉在涇陽宮北門被斬，使齊王府失去了唯一有可能號召舊部、與世民再作一決的軍事首腦；敬君弘、呂世衡的戰死與翌日張士貴部的潰散，則證明北衙宿軍與京師街道上仍留有東宮、齊王系的成建制武力，這股力量若不徹底清除，政變就仍有被翻覆的可能。清除的方式是徹底的：兩府屬官被追誅、貶黜與流放，數十人被逐出京師，玄武門宿衛首長常何因聽命於太子而被貶為潭州都督，宿衛之權自此收歸天子與秦王一系。此役之後，世民於六月初七被立為皇太子，同年八月高祖傳位，世民即位，其後改元貞觀，二十三年後的貞觀之治由此發端：均田、租庸調、三省與科舉、唐律疏議、平突厥與滅高昌，一整套制度與武功，都建立在此日清晨涇陽宮門前的結局之上。更長遠地看，涇陽宮外的馬蹄聲也定了此後數百年宮廷變亂的樣式：父兄兄弟、宗室相殘，以宮門伏擊解決繼承問題，玄武門三字遂成中文裡改朝換代與骨肉相爭的隱語，歷代史家評價從此兩極分化，贊者謂其止亂速定，貶者斥其骨肉相殘、權臣篡位之始。
impactEn: The effect of the Battle of Jingyang was to turn the Xuanwu Gate coup from a successful assassination into a fait accompli that could not be reversed. Yuanji's death at the north gate of Jingyang removed the only man who might have rallied the old retainers and stood against Li Shimin a second time; the deaths of Jing Junhong and Lü Shiheng, and the dispersal of Zhang Shigui's men the following morning, showed that organised military force still remained in the Northern Gate guard and in the streets of the capital, and that unless it was cleared out completely the coup itself remained reversible. It was cleared out completely, and the manner was thorough: the officers of the two princely residences were hunted down, killed, demoted or exiled, several dozen were driven out of the capital, and Chang He, commander of the Xuanwu Gate watch, who had obeyed the crown prince, was demoted to governor of Tanzhou; the custody of the palace guard passed henceforward to the emperor and to the party of the Qin residence. After this the prince was made crown prince on the seventh day of the sixth month, and in the eighth month of the same year Gaozu abdicated and Li Shimin took the throne, the reign afterwards being styled Zhenguan. The twenty-three years of the Zhenguan settlement grew out of the outcome at the gate of Jingyang in that early morning: equal-field distribution, the tax and corvée system, the three departments and the civil service examination, the Tang Code with commentary, the defeat of the Eastern Turks and the taking of Gaochang, a whole system of institutions and of arms, all resting on what was settled before the Jingyang gate. In the longer view, the hoofbeats outside Jingyang also fixed the pattern of palace coups for the centuries that followed: a father and his sons and brothers destroying one another, succession settled by an ambush at a palace gate. The three characters of Xuanwu Gate became in Chinese a byword for a change of dynasty and for fratricide among the royal house, and the judgement of historians has run in two directions ever since, praising the affair for stopping the disorder quickly and condemning it as the beginning of fratricide and of the usurpation of power.
result: 結果是西府集團完勝，齊王系在武力上被徹底消滅。六月初四破曉，元吉逃至涇陽宮北門，敬君弘、呂世衡率護衛力戰，一死於門下，一死於追騎之下，元吉本人被尉遲敬德斬於宮北門；以數十名甲士完成的追擊，未給對方留下任何重整旗鼓的時間。翌日清晨，左屯衛大將軍張士貴率齊王府舊部在京師街道再起抵抗，被世民親率騎兵當面擊破，張士貴被斬。玄武門、涇陽宮、京城街道三處的抵抗至此全部結束，李世民完全控制了皇城與北衙。事後的清理極為徹底：元吉與建成的屍身被分示，兩府屬官或誅或貶或流放，數十名骨幹被逐出京師，北衙宿衛改置，李世民於六月初七立為皇太子，同年八月受禪即位。此役的直接結果是唐帝國的皇位歸屬在一天之內確定；而它的長期結果，則是一個延續近三百年的王朝框架，與一套延續二十三年的貞觀之治。
resultEn: The result was a complete victory for the West Depot party and the military destruction of the Qi party. Before dawn on the fourth day Yuanji reached the north gate of Jingyang Palace, where Jing Junhong and Lü Shiheng led the retainers of the Qi residence in a hard fight and were killed, one at the gate and one under the pursuing horsemen; Yuanji himself was struck down by Yuchi Jingde below the north gate. A pursuit carried out by several dozen armoured men gave the prince no time to rally anything. The next morning Zhang Shigui, commander of the Left Garrison, led the old retainers of the Qi residence into the streets of the capital to resist once more, and was broken in person by Li Shimin's cavalry and killed. With the resistance at Xuanwu Gate, at Jingyang Palace and in the streets of the capital all ended, Li Shimin held the imperial city and the Northern Gate guard completely. The cleanup afterwards was thorough: the bodies of Yuanji and Jiancheng were cut up and displayed, the officers of the two residences were killed, demoted or exiled, several dozen of the hard core were driven out of the capital, the guard of the Northern Gate was reorganised, and Li Shimin was made crown prince on the seventh day of the sixth month and received the abdication in the eighth month of the same year. The direct outcome was that the succession of the Tang empire was settled within a single day. The longer outcome was a dynastic frame that lasted close to three hundred years, and a governing order that lasted twenty-three years.
